current_evidence: The council's 'Planning application forms and validation checklists' page (date updated 9/06/2025) still links the February 2016 checklist set (Full, Householder, LBC, Advert, Demolition, Trees, LDC, DPAR, NMA) and links no newer list. A Planning & Transportation Committee report 'PT Report 12.23 - Validation checklist' exists but could not be fetched (robots-blocked), and no adopted replacement was found.

issues.detail: Several local items in the Full planning checklist were not captured. Heritage: there is no heritage row at all for Full planning, although the list has six heritage items: Listed Buildings (redevelopment or alterations affecting a listed building or its setting), Conservation Areas (affecting a conservation area or its setting), Tower of London World Heritage Site (new buildings or major extensions that could affect it), St Paul's Heights assessment (new buildings or extensions in the designated area), Registered Parks and Gardens, and Non-designated Assets (new buildings or extensions). Also missing: Views assessment (new buildings, major extensions or s73 that could affect protected views or heritage settings); Air Quality Neutral Assessment (major new buildings or extensions); Access Statement (changes to entrances, open spaces, levels or use where no DAS is submitted); Servicing facilities (new buildings, changes of use or major extensions); Housing design; Sustainable development and climate change report (new buildings, major extensions, s73), which appears only indirectly through an Energy row taken from a separate web page; Affordable Housing Statement (10+ residential units), which appears only under Non-material amendment, not Full planning.
issues.evidence: Validation checklist February 2016 (Full): items 'Heritage Assets - Listed Buildings / Conservation Areas / Tower of London World Heritage Site / St Paul's Heights / Registered Parks and Gardens / Non-designated Assets', 'Views assessment', 'Air Quality Neutral Assessment', 'Access Statement', 'Servicing facilities', 'Housing design'

issues.detail: Householder is missing items that the householder checklist sets: Heritage Assets - Listed Buildings (alterations affecting a listed building or its setting), Heritage Assets - Conservation Areas, Heritage Assets - Non-designated Assets (new buildings or extensions including minor extensions), Views assessment (development that could affect protected vistas, panoramas or views, or the setting of listed buildings or conservation areas), and Access Statement (alterations to building entrances and changes of levels).

About 27 full-application requirements are placed under Non-material amendment, including Environmental Statement, Affordable Housing Statement, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan, Statement of Community Involvement, Retail/Town Centre evidence, Open Space and Biodiversity. A s96A non-material amendment does not need these. Grokbot's own excerpts from the NMA PDF cite 'Planning Policy Statement 4' and 'UDP policy ENV 35', which suggests that file holds an old copy of the full-application list. The workbook should not present these as NMA validation requirements.
issues.evidence: NMA rows citing 'Planning Policy Statement 4: Planning for Sustainable Growth' and 'Daylight/Sunlight assessment UDP policy ENV 35'

issues.detail: 'Variation of condition s73' is marked '(none) - national requirements only', but the Full checklist explicitly names s73 removal/variation as a trigger for elevations and sections, Acoustic Report, Environmental Statement, Parking Provision, Sustainable development and climate change report, Travel Plan, Tree survey and Views assessment. Separately, the 'Change of use - prior approval' DAS row comes from the council's change-of-use planning permission guidance page, not from a prior approval requirement.
issues.evidence: Full checklist triggers include 'Section 73 removal or variation of a condition including minor material alterations'

issues.detail: Triggers in the Full planning rows are often taken from the neighbouring table row. Viability Assessment has the Acoustic Report trigger ('Planning applications involving new plant or uses that may create noise disturbance'); the actual trigger is 10+ new residential units. Travel Plan and Arboricultural Impact Assessment both have the Town Centre trigger ('Planning permission for major shopping proposals'); the actual triggers are new buildings, major extensions or s73, and proposals affecting trees. Biodiversity has the Daylight/Sunlight trigger merged in. Flood Risk Assessment has no trigger, only policy codes and the next heading ('...CS18 Heritage Assets Listed Buildings NPPF London Plan Policy 7.8 LVMF'); the actual trigger is all applications in the Flood Risk Area plus major development elsewhere. Drainage/SuDS has no trigger; the actual trigger is major applications.
issues.evidence: Full checklist rows: Affordable Housing and Viability Statement - '10 or more new residential units'; SuDS/Drainage Plan - 'Major applications'; Travel Plan - 'new buildings, major extensions, s73'

issues.detail: The Householder 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' trigger reads 'All planning applications including removal or variation of conditions and minor material alterations'. The householder checklist limits FRA and sequential test evidence to applications in the Flood Risk Area (Core Strategy Proposals Map B) and major development elsewhere. The Householder 'Arboricultural' trigger 'All applications' is also wrong: the source requires a tree survey only where trees in or next to the site, including street trees, may be affected.
issues.evidence: Householder checklist: 'Required for all planning applications in the Flood Risk Area shown on the Core Strategy Proposals Map B'; 'Required if proposal is likely to affect trees within the application site or adjacent to the site'

issues.detail: Several 'Submission rules' tab items are download-link listings from guidance web pages, not requirements, e.g. 'Planning for Sustainability SPD PDF (5MB) Date submitted: 19/02/25 ...', 'Carbon Options Tool XLSX (3.3MB) Date submitted: 19/12/25 ...', 'Third Party Review Governance Guidance PDF (700KB) ...', 'Design and Access Statement PDF (63KB) Date submitted: 11/01/20 St Paul's Heights Request Form ...', 'Submission of planning documents and supporting documents PDF (29KB) ...'. The Full planning 'Pre-application advice' row ('DM1.5) and pre-application discussions suggest the use could be acceptable.') is a fragment of the office viability item. The Full planning 'Statement of Community Involvement' row has SPD download text as its trigger. The checklist's actual SCI trigger is where community involvement was arranged before applying.
issues.evidence: Workbook tab_items under 'Submission rules' sourced from sustainable-development-planning-requirements and major-applications web pages

issues.detail: The file-size rule ('maximum file size acceptable is 2 MB (exceptionally 5 MB...)') is repeated five times, once per checklist PDF, with table-header fragments attached. The drawing standard 'Plans should be proportionate...' appears twice (once prefixed 'When or what information is required'). Under Works to trees, the 'Schedule of works (listed building)' row ('and Arboricultural method statement.') is a mislabelled fragment of the arboricultural report item.
issues.evidence: Tab items 1-2 and 'Submission rules' items 1-5; Works to trees row trigger 'and Arboricultural method statement.'

issues.detail: The Corporation's 'PT Report 12.23 - Validation checklist' (Planning & Transportation Committee, Dec 2023) indicates a review of the 2016 checklists, and City Plan 2040 has since progressed. The forms page still links only the Feb 2016 set, so it remains current, but the outdated status should be noted and the row rechecked for a replacement list.

summary: The workbook links the City's February 2016 Full checklist, which the council's forms page still lists as current, so the link and date are right, though the list is badly outdated. The extraction misses all heritage, views, AQ-neutral, access and servicing items, misassigns many triggers from adjacent table rows, puts the whole full list under Non-material amendment, and pads 'Submission rules' with download-link text.
